proof.contract: Compute (a AND b) OR c, with binary inputs. Emit 0 or 1.
proof.argument: Known agreeing service input requires one result but the exact service observation is the other; hidden transformations are excluded.

proof.contract: Begin in q0. Read the word left to right. Transitions: q0 on a -> q1, on b -> q0; q1 on a -> q1, on b -> q2; q2 on a -> q3, on b -> q0; q3 on either letter stays q3. Emit the final state name.
proof.argument: Current and earlier observations match their known requirements; the bounded input and capture evidence is complete and agreeing.

proof.contract: Starting from start, follow any number of directed edges, including zero. Emit five bits for vertices 0,1,2,3,4 in that order: 1 exactly when reachable, otherwise 0.
proof.argument: The service input is uncaptured. Both supplied admissible inputs remain possible, but only one yields the observed result; no declaration distinguishes them.

proof.contract: Emit the minimum number of single-character insertions, deletions or substitutions needed to turn left into right. Each operation costs one; no transposition operation is allowed.
proof.argument: The earlier build observation violates its known requirement; the explicitly in-service newer build matches its requirement.

proof.contract: Emit the greatest positive integer dividing both positive integers x and y exactly.
proof.argument: Two equal-standing declarations of one immutable service-input event identify different operands, with no additional source to resolve the incompatibility.

proof.contract: For every consecutive window of three values, emit its maximum, in starting-position order. Encode the resulting integers as a comma-separated string without spaces.
proof.argument: Known agreeing service input requires one result but the exact service observation is the other; hidden transformations are excluded.

proof.contract: For zero-based indices, y[k] is the sum of a[i]*b[j] over i+j=k. Indices outside the supplied arrays contribute nothing. Emit all len(a)+len(b)-1 coefficients as comma-separated signed decimal integers without spaces.
proof.argument: Current and earlier observations match their known requirements; the bounded input and capture evidence is complete and agreeing.

proof.contract: Emit the number of starting positions at which pattern occurs exactly in text. Count overlapping occurrences separately.
